title: Çiçekçide İlk Sabah
plot: A new helper in a small flower shop asks about colors, numbers and a simple bouquet order. Branches lead to four distinct helpful outcomes; no assumed job knowledge.

title: Pencere Önündeki Saksılar
plot: A newcomer meets neighbors through flowers on a shared window ledge. Use introductions, locations and polite simple questions; no claims about tenancy law.

title: Yağmurdan Sonra Piknik
plot: Two friends adjust a picnic after rain. A dry bench, a covered courtyard, a garden and a friendly cafe offer genuinely different small adventures.

title: Pazar Sepetindeki Liste
plot: A handwritten shopping list leads through a friendly market. Practice fruit, quantities, simple prices and asking what an unfamiliar item is.

title: Fırından Gelen Koku
plot: Neighbors prepare a shared baking afternoon. Explain a missing ingredient, ask for help and choose between changing plans and sharing tasks; no technical oven instructions.

title: Mavi Anahtarlık
plot: A blue bicycle keyring is found near the library. Compare public clues and ask staff without revealing private addresses; four plausible ways to find or safely await the owner.

title: Yolu Gösteren Fener
plot: A friendly lantern lights different garden paths when people ask kind questions. Choices determine what the characters discover, without danger or frightening creatures.

title: Kütüphanede Deneme Günü
plot: A learner helps at a fictional library open day. Clarify a task, explain available time and decide how to organize a welcoming reading corner.

title: Küçük Feribot Yolculuğu
plot: Two travelers plan a calm daytime ferry excursion and respond to a changed timetable. Distinct endings focus on the island garden, waterfront village, market or a later trip, no emergency.

title: Mahallenin Takas Rafı
plot: A newcomer discovers a neighborhood exchange shelf. Explain what can be shared, read the organizers' simple fictional rules and choose how to contribute.

title: Son Domates Kasası
plot: The last tomato crate at a market prompts a discussion about sharing, cooking together and changing a shopping plan. Give reasons and recount what happened without moral pressure.

title: Eski Fotoğraftaki Yeni Plan
plot: Two friends find an old group photograph and plan a small reunion. Ask permission before sharing photos and respect a friend who prefers a quiet meeting.

title: Rüzgâr Postanesi
plot: A magical post office carries friendly messages in the wind. An unsigned public greeting needs context; decide whether to ask, display a neutral notice or write a new invitation.

title: Bisiklet Rotasındaki Değişiklik
plot: An ordinary signed cycle-path diversion changes a relaxed day trip. Compare time, companions' preferences and public route information; no dangerous maneuvers.

title: Okul Radyosunun İlk Yayını
plot: An adult language class produces its first school radio program. Resolve a recording mistake, divide tasks and credit contributors while explaining opinions.

title: Bir Yanlış Anlaşılmanın Ardından
plot: A brief text message sounded colder than intended. Friends separate assumptions from what was actually written, listen and choose different respectful ways to reconnect.

title: Avludaki Bahar Şenliği
plot: Neighbors organize a courtyard spring gathering. Balance quiet and sociable activities through requests and reasons; all event rules are fictional agreements, not German legal advice.

title: Tarif Defterinin Yeni Sayfası
plot: A family recipe notebook inspires a community dinner. Distinguish preserving a tradition from allowing adaptations, and explain changes transparently without invented cultural claims.

title: İki Arkadaş, Bir Sergi
plot: Friends preparing an exhibition disagree about selection and credit. Compare artistic aims, negotiate boundaries and produce distinct cooperative or independent outcomes.

title: Dakikaların Açtığı Bahçe
plot: A magical garden grows flowers when attention is freely given, not when people rush. Four branches explore curiosity, rest, cooperation and leaving room for unfinished work.

title: Adanın İki Yolu
plot: Visitors compare two fictional island routes and learn why an area is temporarily closed. Choose informed alternatives, question assumptions and consider companions without shaming them.

title: Mahalle Gazetesinin Açık Sayfası
plot: A neighborhood newspaper receives conflicting accounts of a community project. Compare sources, seek clarification and distinguish an opinion column from a report.

title: Tasarım Atölyesindeki İki Öneri
plot: A design workshop has two feasible plans and limited time. Weigh accessibility, materials and clarity; four endings arise from transparent priorities rather than one perfect answer.

title: Gecikmiş Kartpostalın Rotası
plot: A delayed postcard arrives at a public bookshop with an ambiguous place name. Use dates, public maps and the shop archive to reconstruct several plausible routes without a crime plot.

title: Durmuş Saatin Etrafında
plot: A stopped decorative clock in a shared reading room triggers a nuanced discussion of routine, memory and practical usefulness. Avoid electrical repair instructions and grief themes.

title: Birlikte Yazılan Sessizlik
plot: Two friends co-write a short stage text and disagree about a deliberate pause. Explore subtext, listening and preserving different interpretations without forcing agreement.

title: Bahçe Arşivindeki Boş Sayfa
plot: A missing page in a fictional community garden archive invites several explanations. Compare the limits of documentary evidence and preserve uncertainty without sensationalism.

title: Gece Trenindeki Pencere
plot: A comfortable overnight train journey brings several perspectives on the same landscape. Choices explore conversation, observation, an audio guide and a shared travel note; no threat or emergency.

title: Çeviri Masasındaki Anlamlar
plot: A team translates an original short museum text with an ambiguous key phrase. Weigh audience, register and retained ambiguity, with no copyrighted source material.

title: Mahallenin Sessiz Köşesi
plot: Residents discuss how a fictional neighborhood reading space can welcome conversation while protecting quiet study. Different negotiated arrangements retain tradeoffs.

title: Yeryüzüne Çizilen Yıldız Haritası
plot: A whimsical map projects stars onto garden paths, but the pattern changes with the questions asked. Explore interpretation, cooperation and accepting incomplete knowledge; no pseudo-scientific claims.

title: Gündelik Olanın Kenar Notları
plot: An essay workshop reconsiders a supposedly trivial daily observation. Distinguish precise detail, imposed symbolism and retrospective storytelling through nuanced voices.

title: Söylenmeyen Cümlenin Ardından
plot: Friends revisit an unfinished sentence after a collaborative event. Explore implicature, irony and respectful non-disclosure without assuming motives or forcing emotional resolution.

title: Adını Değiştiren Ev
plot: A benign magical house changes the names of its rooms when visitors tell different stories. Four endings explore identity, language and shared space without erasing anyone's memories.

title: Bir Rehberin Dipnotlarında
plot: An original fictional travel guide has notes that complicate its confident main narrative. Compare narrative authority, selective description and situated perspectives without inventing real history.

title: Bir Meydanın Birden Çok Adı
plot: People in a fictional German neighborhood use different informal names for the same square. Trace contexts of naming and belonging without making claims about actual municipal regulations.

title: Açılış Konuşmasının Kaybolan Noktası
plot: At an art opening, one missing full stop turns a serious speech into a chain of harmless misunderstandings. Use subtle situational humor, irony and register shifts without mocking identities.

title: Aynadaki Notun Yazarı
plot: A playful unsigned note in a public writers' studio can be read in two ways. Test interpretations and authorship hypotheses using textual evidence, not a detective crime or private surveillance.
